pages.text: With Ex Deorum installed the mod adds seven sieve meshes, so you can get the materials without mining a single ore. Made for skyblock.

The order is: $(b)Steel$() above the iron one, and after the netherite one come $(b)Mushashite$(), $(b)Joanfoite$() and $(b)Nadienite$().$(br2)Each mesh is crafted by putting the previous tier in the center, surrounded by ingots of the new material and string in the corners.

The chain bootstraps itself: Ex Deorum's $(b)netherite mesh$() already drops Raw Mushashite, and the diamond one does too, just less often. From there each of our meshes drops the next material.$(br2)They work on gravel, sand, crushed deepslate and crushed netherrack, in both the normal and the compressed sieve.
On top of that, the $(b)Mushashite$(), $(b)Joanfoite$() and $(b)Nadienite$() blocks work as crucible heat sources, with values 2, 3 and 4. The Nadienite one is hotter than lava.
